```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(class)
library(caret)


rap_raw <- read.csv("D:/Coding - R/TPAB Music recs/data/Rap_songs.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cat("Dataset has", nrow(rap_raw), "rows and", ncol(rap_raw), "columns\n")


lyric_cols <- grep("lyric", colnames(rap_raw), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
title_cols <- grep("title", colnames(rap_raw), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
artist_cols <- grep("artist", colnames(rap_raw), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
album_cols <- grep("album", colnames(rap_raw), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)

cat("Lyric columns found:", paste(lyric_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Title columns found:", paste(title_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Artist columns found:", paste(artist_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Album columns found:", paste(album_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")



# Create clean dataset
rap_clean <- data.frame(
  lyrics = rap_raw[, 1],
  artist = if(ncol(rap_raw) >= 2) rap_raw[, 2] else rep("Unknown", nrow(rap_raw)),
  album = if(ncol(rap_raw) >= 3) rap_raw[, 3] else rep("Unknown", nrow(rap_raw)),
  title = if(ncol(rap_raw) >= 5) rap_raw[, 5] else paste("Track", 1:nrow(rap_raw)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Clean the data
rap_clean <- rap_clean %>%
  # Remove rows with missing or very short lyrics
  filter(!is.na(lyrics), nchar(trimws(lyrics)) > 100) %>%
  # Clean up whitespace
  mutate(
    lyrics = str_trim(lyrics),
    lyrics = gsub("\\s+", " ", lyrics),
    # Clean other fields
    artist = str_trim(artist),
    album = str_trim(album),
    title = str_trim(title),
    # Create a combined track identifier
    track_name = paste(artist, "-", title)
  ) %>%
  # Remove duplicates
  distinct(artist, title, .keep_all = TRUE)


if(nrow(rap_clean) == 0) {
  cat("\n❌ ERROR: No songs remaining after cleaning!\n")
  cat("   Possible reasons:\n")
  cat("   1. Lyrics column might not be column 1\n")
  cat("   2. Lyrics might be in a different format\n")
  cat("   3. Filter threshold (100 chars) might be too high\n")
  
 
  rap_clean <- data.frame(
    lyrics = rap_raw[, 1],
    artist = if(ncol(rap_raw) >= 2) rap_raw[, 2] else rep("Unknown", nrow(rap_raw)),
    album = if(ncol(rap_raw) >= 3) rap_raw[, 3] else rep("Unknown", nrow(rap_raw)),
    title = if(ncol(rap_raw) >= 5) rap_raw[, 5] else paste("Track", 1:nrow(rap_raw)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(lyrics), nchar(trimws(lyrics)) > 50) %>%
    mutate(
      lyrics = str_trim(lyrics),
      lyrics = gsub("\\s+", " ", lyrics),
      artist = str_trim(artist),
      album = str_trim(album),
      title = str_trim(title),
      track_name = paste(artist, "-", title)
    ) %>%
    distinct(artist, title, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  cat("After cleaning with 50 char threshold:", nrow(rap_clean), "songs\n")
}

if(nrow(rap_clean) == 0) {
  stop("Cannot proceed: No songs found in dataset. Please check your CSV file structure.")
}


output_dir <- "data/processed"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
write.csv(rap_clean, file.path(output_dir, "rap_songs_clean.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n✅ Saved clean dataset to:", file.path(output_dir, "rap_songs_clean.csv"), "\n")


extract_thematic_features <- function(lyrics_text) {
  if (is.na(lyrics_text) || nchar(lyrics_text) < 10) {
    return(data.frame(
      sentiment_mean = 0,
      sentiment_volatility = 0,
      sentiment_range = 0,
      theme_justice = 0,
      theme_self = 0,
      theme_spirituality = 0,
      theme_money = 0
    ))
  }
  
  # word splitting
  words <- unlist(strsplit(tolower(lyrics_text), "\\W+"))
  words <- words[words != ""]
  
  # Simple sentiment lexicon
  afinn_lexicon <- data.frame(
    word = c("good", "great", "excellent", "love", "happy", "positive", 
             "joy", "hope", "peace", "beautiful",
             "bad", "terrible", "hate", "sad", "negative", "pain",
             "anger", "fight", "war", "death"),
    value = c(3, 4, 4, 3, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2,
              -3, -5, -3, -2, -2, -3, -3, -2, -4, -4)
  )
  
  # Calculate sentiment
  sentiment_values <- afinn_lexicon$value[match(words, afinn_lexicon$word)]
  sentiment_values <- sentiment_values[!is.na(sentiment_values)]
  
  if (length(sentiment_values) > 0) {
    sentiment_mean <- mean(sentiment_values)
    sentiment_volatility <- ifelse(length(sentiment_values) > 1, sd(sentiment_values), 0)
    sentiment_range <- max(sentiment_values) - min(sentiment_values)
  } else {
    sentiment_mean <- sentiment_volatility <- sentiment_range <- 0
  }
  
  # Custom theme dictionaries
  themes <- list(
    theme_justice = c("oppression", "power", "fight", "racism", "police", 
                      "justice", "inequality", "protest", "black", "white",
                      "rights", "freedom", "equality", "struggle"),
    theme_self = c("i", "me", "my", "mine", "myself", "self", "i'm", "i'll"),
    theme_spirituality = c("god", "faith", "pray", "heaven", "hell", 
                           "sin", "bless", "soul", "spirit", "jesus",
                           "lord", "church", "bible", "religious"),
    theme_money = c("money", "cash", "dollar", "cost", "rich", 
                    "poor", "price", "wealth", "broke", "bank",
                    "pay", "paid", "cash", "gold", "diamonds")
  )
  
  # Calculate theme densities
  theme_densities <- sapply(themes, function(theme_words) {
    sum(words %in% theme_words) / max(length(words), 1)
  })
  
  # Add lexical diversity feature
  lexical_diversity <- ifelse(length(words) > 0, 
                              length(unique(words)) / length(words), 0)
  
  # Add average word length
  avg_word_length <- ifelse(length(words) > 0, mean(nchar(words)), 0)
  
  return(data.frame(
    sentiment_mean = sentiment_mean,
    sentiment_volatility = sentiment_volatility,
    sentiment_range = sentiment_range,
    theme_justice = theme_densities["theme_justice"],
    theme_self = theme_densities["theme_self"],
    theme_spirituality = theme_densities["theme_spirituality"],
    theme_money = theme_densities["theme_money"],
    lexical_diversity = lexical_diversity,
    avg_word_length = avg_word_length,
    word_count = length(words)
  ))
}

# 8. Extract features in batches


if(nrow(rap_clean) > 0) {
  # Process in manageable batches
  batch_size <- min(500, nrow(rap_clean))
  num_batches <- ceiling(nrow(rap_clean) / batch_size)
  
  cat(sprintf("Processing in %d batches of up to %d songs each\n", num_batches, batch_size))
  
  all_features <- list()
  
  for(batch in 1:num_batches) {
    start_idx <- (batch - 1) * batch_size + 1
    end_idx <- min(batch * batch_size, nrow(rap_clean))
    
    cat(sprintf("  Processing batch %d/%d (songs %d-%d)\n", 
                batch, num_batches, start_idx, end_idx))
    
    batch_lyrics <- rap_clean$lyrics[start_idx:end_idx]
    batch_features <- do.call(rbind, lapply(batch_lyrics, extract_thematic_features))
    all_features[[batch]] <- batch_features
  }
  
  thematic_features <- do.call(rbind, all_features)
  

  # 9. Combine with track info
  rap_features <- rap_clean %>%
    select(artist, title, track_name, lyrics) %>%
    bind_cols(thematic_features) %>%
    rename(artist_name = artist, track_name_short = title)
  
 
  output_path <- file.path(output_dir, "rap_features_full.csv")
  write.csv(rap_features, output_path, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("   Saved features to:", output_path, "\n")
  
  # 11. Load TPAB features
  tpab_features_path <- "D:/Coding - R/TPAB Music recs/scripts/data/processed/tpab_features_full.csv"
  
  if(file.exists(tpab_features_path)) {
    tpab_features <- read.csv(tpab_features_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    cat("Loaded TPAB features with", nrow(tpab_features), "songs\n")
    
  
    
  } else {
    cat("❌ ERROR: TPAB features file not found at:", tpab_features_path, "\n")
    cat("   Please make sure the TPAB analysis was run first.\n")
  }
  
} else {
  cat("❌ ERROR: No songs to process. Cannot continue with feature extraction.\n")
}
# 10. Prepare datasets 


# Prepare TPAB features
tpab_for_knn <- tpab_features %>%
  mutate(
    artist_name = "Kendrick Lamar",
    album = "To Pimp A Butterfly",
    track_name = paste(artist_name, "-", track_name)
  ) %>%
  select(artist_name, track_name, 
         sentiment_mean, sentiment_volatility, sentiment_range,
         theme_justice, theme_self, theme_spirituality, theme_money)

# Prepare rap features 
rap_for_knn <- rap_features %>%
  mutate(
    track_name = paste(artist_name, "-", track_name_short)
  ) %>%
  select(artist_name, track_name, 
         sentiment_mean, sentiment_volatility, sentiment_range,
         theme_justice, theme_self, theme_spirituality, theme_money,
         lexical_diversity, avg_word_length, word_count)

# Add missing columns to TPAB (set to 0)
tpab_for_knn$lexical_diversity <- 0
tpab_for_knn$avg_word_length <- 0
tpab_for_knn$word_count <- 0

# Combine datasets
all_songs <- bind_rows(
  tpab_for_knn,
  rap_for_knn
)

# 11. Prepare
feature_columns <- c("sentiment_mean", "sentiment_volatility", "sentiment_range",
                     "theme_justice", "theme_self", "theme_spirituality", "theme_money",
                     "lexical_diversity", "avg_word_length", "word_count")

feature_matrix <- all_songs[, feature_columns]
feature_matrix[is.na(feature_matrix)] <- 0

# Scale features
scaler <- preProcess(feature_matrix, method = c("center", "scale"))
feature_scaled <- predict(scaler, feature_matrix)

# Create song identifiers
song_ids <- all_songs$track_name

# 12. KNN function
find_similar_songs <- function(target_song_name, feature_data, song_names, k = 5) {
  target_idx <- which(song_names == target_song_name)
  
  if (length(target_idx) == 0) {
    stop("Song not found: ", target_song_name)
  }
  
  train_data <- feature_data[-target_idx, ]
  train_names <- song_names[-target_idx]
  test_point <- feature_data[target_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # KNN
  knn_result <- knn(train = train_data, test = test_point, 
                    cl = 1:nrow(train_data), k = k)
  
  # Get distances
  distances <- as.matrix(dist(rbind(test_point, train_data)))[1, -1]
  
  # Get indices of nearest neighbors
  neighbor_indices <- attr(knn_result, "nn.index")
  
  # Create results
  results <- data.frame(
    query_song = target_song_name,
    recommended_song = train_names[neighbor_indices],
    distance = distances[neighbor_indices],
    rank = 1:k,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  return(results)
}

# 13. Find songs similar to TPAB tracks

tpab_tracks <- all_songs %>% 
  filter(artist_name == "Kendrick Lamar") %>%
  pull(track_name)

for(i in seq_along(tpab_tracks)) {
  cat(sprintf("%2d. %s\n", i, tpab_tracks[i]))
}

# Find similar songs 
all_recommendations <- data.frame()

# few TPAB tracks
tpab_tracks_to_check <- head(tpab_tracks, 3)

for(track in tpab_tracks_to_check) {
  cat(sprintf("\nFinding songs similar to: %s\n", track))
  
  tryCatch({
    similar <- find_similar_songs(
      target_song_name = track,
      feature_data = feature_scaled,
      song_names = song_ids,
      k = 5
    )
    
    # Filter to only show non-TPAB songs
    similar_non_tpab <- similar %>%
      filter(!grepl("Kendrick Lamar", recommended_song))
    
    if(nrow(similar_non_tpab) > 0) {
      cat("Top recommendations:\n")
      print(similar_non_tpab)
      all_recommendations <- bind_rows(all_recommendations, 
                                       cbind(query_track = track, similar_non_tpab))
    } else {
      cat("   No non-TPAB recommendations found.\n")
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("   Error:", e$message, "\n")
  })
}

# 14. Save recommendations
if(nrow(all_recommendations) > 0) {
  recs_dir <- "outputs"
  if(!dir.exists(recs_dir)) dir.create(recs_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  
  write.csv(all_recommendations, 
            file.path(recs_dir, "tpab_similar_rap_songs.csv"), 
            row.names = FALSE)
  
  cat(sprintf("\n✅ Saved %d recommendations to: %s\n", 
              nrow(all_recommendations), 
              file.path(recs_dir, "tpab_similar_rap_songs.csv")))
  
  # Show top recommendations
  top_recs <- all_recommendations %>%
    group_by(recommended_song) %>%
    summarise(
      times_recommended = n(),
      avg_distance = mean(distance)
    ) %>%
    arrange(avg_distance) %>%
    head(10)
  
  print(top_recs)
}

# 15. Alternative: Find most central songs in the dataset

# Calculate centroid of all songs
centroid <- colMeans(feature_scaled)

# Find songs closest to the centroid
centroid_distances <- apply(feature_scaled, 1, function(x) {
  sqrt(sum((x - centroid)^2))
})

representative_songs <- data.frame(
  track_name = song_ids,
  distance_to_centroid = centroid_distances,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  arrange(distance_to_centroid)

cat("\nTop 10 most representative songs (closest to center of all songs):\n")
print(head(representative_songs, 10))

# Save representative songs
write.csv(representative_songs, 
          file.path(recs_dir, "representative_songs.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)

# 16. Create simple visualizations

if (!dir.exists("outputs")) dir.create("outputs", recursive = TRUE)

# Plot: Distribution of distances for representative songs
png("outputs/representative_songs_histogram.png", width = 800, height = 600)
hist(representative_songs$distance_to_centroid, 
     main = "Distribution of Song Distances from Centroid",
     xlab = "Distance from Centroid",
     ylab = "Number of Songs",
     col = "lightblue",
     breaks = 30)
abline(v = mean(representative_songs$distance_to_centroid), 
       col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
legend("topright", 
       legend = paste("Mean distance:", round(mean(representative_songs$distance_to_centroid), 3)),
       col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
dev.off()

cat("\n✅ Visualizations saved to outputs/ directory\n")

cat("\n" , strrep("=", 60), "\n")
cat("ANALYSIS COMPLETE!\n")
cat("\nWhat we've done:\n")
cat("1. Loaded and cleaned your rap songs dataset\n")
cat("2. Extracted thematic features from all songs\n")
cat("3. Combined with TPAB features\n")

cat("2. Check outputs/representative_songs.csv for central songs\n")

cat("4. Add more songs to your dataset for better comparisons\n")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

cat("\n=== SEARCHING FOR COLUMNS WITH LYRICS CONTENT ===\n")

# Function to check if text looks like lyrics
is_likely_lyrics <- function(text) {
  if(is.na(text)) return(FALSE)
  text <- trimws(text)
  if(nchar(text) < 100) return(FALSE)
  
  # Lyrics often have:
  # - Brackets for [Verse], [Chorus]
  # - Line breaks
  # - Common words in lyrics
  has_brackets <- grepl("\\[.*\\]", text)
  has_line_breaks <- grepl("\n", text)
  common_words <- c("verse", "chorus", "intro", "outro", "hook", "yeah", "oh", "baby")
  has_common_words <- any(sapply(common_words, function(word) grepl(word, text, ignore.case = TRUE)))
  
  return(has_brackets || has_line_breaks || has_common_words)
}

# Search all columns for lyrics
lyrics_column_found <- NULL
for(col in colnames(rap_raw)) {
  # Check first 10 rows of this column
  sample_rows <- rap_raw[1:10, col]
  lyric_count <- sum(sapply(sample_rows, is_likely_lyrics))
  
  if(lyric_count > 5) {  # If more than 5 of first 10 rows look like lyrics
    lyrics_column_found <- col
    cat(sprintf("Found lyrics in column: %s (%d of first 10 rows contain lyrics)\n", col, lyric_count))
    break
  }
}

if(is.null(lyrics_column_found)) {
  cat("\n❌ Could not find lyrics column automatically. Let's check manually...\n")
  
  # Check a few random rows more thoroughly
  for(row_idx in c(1, 100, 500, 1000)) {
    cat(sprintf("\nChecking row %d:\n", row_idx))
    for(col_idx in 1:min(20, ncol(rap_raw))) {
      content <- rap_raw[row_idx, col_idx]
      if(!is.na(content) && nchar(content) > 200) {
        cat(sprintf("  Column %d (%s): %s...\n", col_idx, colnames(rap_raw)[col_idx], 
                    substr(content, 1, 100)))
      }
    }
  }
} else {
  cat(sprintf("\n✅ Using column '%s' for lyrics\n", lyrics_column_found))
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(class)
library(caret)

# SIMPLE VERSION: Just get lyrics and song names, then run KNN
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(class)
library(caret)

# 1. Load the dataset
rap_raw <- read.csv("D:/Coding - R/TPAB Music recs/data/Rap_songs.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cat("Dataset has", nrow(rap_raw), "rows\n")

# 2. SIMPLEST APPROACH: Just find the column that looks like lyrics
# Look for any column that contains actual song lyrics
find_lyrics_column <- function(data) {
  for(col in colnames(data)) {
    # Check first 10 rows of this column
    sample_rows <- data[1:10, col]
    
    # Count how many look like lyrics (long text with brackets or common lyric words)
    lyric_count <- sum(sapply(sample_rows, function(text) {
      if(is.na(text) || nchar(text) < 100) return(FALSE)
      
      has_brackets <- grepl("\\[.*\\]", text)  # [Verse], [Chorus]
      has_common_words <- grepl("verse|chorus|intro|outro|hook|yeah|oh", tolower(text))
      has_line_breaks <- grepl("\n", text)
      
      return(has_brackets || has_common_words || has_line_breaks)
    }))
    
    if(lyric_count >= 3) {  # If at least 3 of first 10 rows look like lyrics
      return(col)
    }
  }
  return(NULL)
}

# Find lyrics column
lyrics_col <- find_lyrics_column(rap_raw)

if(is.null(lyrics_col)) {
  # If automatic detection fails, try to find any column with long text
  cat("Could not find lyrics column automatically. Searching for any text column...\n")
  
  for(col in colnames(rap_raw)) {
    max_len <- max(nchar(rap_raw[[col]]), na.rm = TRUE)
    if(max_len > 500) {
      lyrics_col <- col
      cat("Found column with long text:", col, "(up to", max_len, "chars)\n")
      break
    }
  }
}

if(is.null(lyrics_col)) {
  stop("Cannot find lyrics column. Please check your CSV file.")
}

cat("Using column '", lyrics_col, "' for lyrics\n", sep="")

# 3. Get song titles - use another column or create simple names
# Look for a column that might have song titles (short text, no line breaks)
find_title_column <- function(data, exclude_col) {
  for(col in colnames(data)) {
    if(col == exclude_col) next
    
    sample_vals <- na.omit(data[1:20, col])
    if(length(sample_vals) == 0) next
    
    avg_length <- mean(nchar(sample_vals))
    
    # Titles are usually short (2-50 chars), no line breaks
    if(avg_length > 2 && avg_length < 50 && !any(grepl("\n", sample_vals))) {
      cat("Potential title column:", col, "(avg length:", round(avg_length, 1), "chars)\n")
      return(col)
    }
  }
  return(NULL)
}

title_col <- find_title_column(rap_raw, lyrics_col)

if(is.null(title_col)) {
  cat("No title column found. Using row numbers as song names.\n")
  rap_clean <- data.frame(
    lyrics = rap_raw[[lyrics_col]],
    song_name = paste("Song", 1:nrow(rap_raw)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
} else {
  cat("Using column '", title_col, "' for song titles\n", sep="")
  rap_clean <- data.frame(
    lyrics = rap_raw[[lyrics_col]],
    song_name = rap_raw[[title_col]],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# 4. Clean the data - remove NA/empty lyrics
cat("\nCleaning data...\n")
rap_clean <- rap_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(lyrics), nchar(trimws(lyrics)) > 50) %>%
  mutate(
    lyrics = str_trim(lyrics),
    lyrics = gsub("\\s+", " ", lyrics),
    song_name = ifelse(is.na(song_name) | nchar(trimws(song_name)) == 0, 
                      paste("Song", 1:n()), str_trim(song_name))
  ) %>%
  distinct(song_name, .keep_all = TRUE)  # Remove duplicate song names

cat("After cleaning:", nrow(rap_clean), "songs with lyrics\n")

if(nrow(rap_clean) == 0) {
  stop("No songs found after cleaning!")
}

# 5. Feature extraction function (SAME AS BEFORE)
extract_thematic_features <- function(lyrics_text) {
  if (is.na(lyrics_text) || nchar(lyrics_text) < 10) {
    return(data.frame(
      sentiment_mean = 0,
      sentiment_volatility = 0,
      sentiment_range = 0,
      theme_justice = 0,
      theme_self = 0,
      theme_spirituality = 0,
      theme_money = 0
    ))
  }
  
  # Simple word splitting
  words <- unlist(strsplit(tolower(lyrics_text), "\\W+"))
  words <- words[words != ""]
  
  # Simple sentiment lexicon
  afinn_lexicon <- data.frame(
    word = c("good", "great", "excellent", "love", "happy", "positive", 
             "joy", "hope", "peace", "beautiful",
             "bad", "terrible", "hate", "sad", "negative", "pain",
             "anger", "fight", "war", "death"),
    value = c(3, 4, 4, 3, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2,
              -3, -5, -3, -2, -2, -3, -3, -2, -4, -4)
  )
  
  # Calculate sentiment
  sentiment_values <- afinn_lexicon$value[match(words, afinn_lexicon$word)]
  sentiment_values <- sentiment_values[!is.na(sentiment_values)]
  
  if (length(sentiment_values) > 0) {
    sentiment_mean <- mean(sentiment_values)
    sentiment_volatility <- ifelse(length(sentiment_values) > 1, sd(sentiment_values), 0)
    sentiment_range <- max(sentiment_values) - min(sentiment_values)
  } else {
    sentiment_mean <- sentiment_volatility <- sentiment_range <- 0
  }
  
  # Custom theme dictionaries
  themes <- list(
    theme_justice = c("oppression", "power", "fight", "racism", "police", 
                      "justice", "inequality", "protest", "black", "white",
                      "rights", "freedom", "equality", "struggle"),
    theme_self = c("i", "me", "my", "mine", "myself", "self", "i'm", "i'll"),
    theme_spirituality = c("god", "faith", "pray", "heaven", "hell", 
                           "sin", "bless", "soul", "spirit", "jesus",
                           "lord", "church", "bible", "religious"),
    theme_money = c("money", "cash", "dollar", "cost", "rich", 
                    "poor", "price", "wealth", "broke", "bank",
                    "pay", "paid", "cash", "gold", "diamonds")
  )
  
  # Calculate theme densities
  theme_densities <- sapply(themes, function(theme_words) {
    sum(words %in% theme_words) / max(length(words), 1)
  })
  
  # Add lexical diversity feature
  lexical_diversity <- ifelse(length(words) > 0, 
                              length(unique(words)) / length(words), 0)
  
  # Add average word length
  avg_word_length <- ifelse(length(words) > 0, mean(nchar(words)), 0)
  
  return(data.frame(
    sentiment_mean = sentiment_mean,
    sentiment_volatility = sentiment_volatility,
    sentiment_range = sentiment_range,
    theme_justice = theme_densities["theme_justice"],
    theme_self = theme_densities["theme_self"],
    theme_spirituality = theme_densities["theme_spirituality"],
    theme_money = theme_densities["theme_money"],
    lexical_diversity = lexical_diversity,
    avg_word_length = avg_word_length,
    word_count = length(words)
  ))
}

# 6. Extract features

                     "lexical_diversity", "avg_word_length", "word_count")

# Song identifiers

# 10. KNN function
find_similar_songs <- function(target_song_name, feature_data, song_names, k = 5) {
  target_idx <- which(song_names == target_song_name)
  
  if (length(target_idx) == 0) {
    stop("Song not found: ", target_song_name)
  }
  
  train_data <- feature_data[-target_idx, ]
  train_names <- song_names[-target_idx]
  test_point <- feature_data[target_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # KNN
  knn_result <- knn(train = train_data, test = test_point, 
                    cl = 1:nrow(train_data), k = k)
  
  # Get distances
  distances <- as.matrix(dist(rbind(test_point, train_data)))[1, -1]
  
  # Get neighbor indices
  neighbor_indices <- attr(knn_result, "nn.index")
  
  # Create results
  results <- data.frame(
    query_song = target_song_name,
    recommended_song = train_names[neighbor_indices],
    distance = distances[neighbor_indices],
    rank = 1:k,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  return(results)
}

# 11. Find similar songs

      target_song_name = track,
      feature_data = feature_scaled,
      song_names = song_ids,
      k = 5
    )
    
    # Filter out TPAB songs from recommendations
    similar_rap <- similar %>% filter(!grepl("Kendrick Lamar", recommended_song))
    
    if(nrow(similar_rap) > 0) {
      cat("Top recommendations:\n")
      print(similar_rap[, c("recommended_song", "distance")])
      all_recommendations <- bind_rows(all_recommendations, 
                                       cbind(query_track = track, similar_rap))
    } else {
      cat("No rap song recommendations found.\n")
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error:", e$message, "\n")
  })
}

# 12. Save results
if(nrow(all_recommendations) > 0) {
  recs_dir <- "outputs"
  if(!dir.exists(recs_dir)) dir.create(recs_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  
  write.csv(all_recommendations, 
            file.path(recs_dir, "tpab_similar_rap_songs_simple.csv"),
```

```{r}
# 5. CORRECTED KNN FUNCTION FOR FINDING NEAREST NEIGHBORS
cat("\nFinding nearest neighbors using KNN...\n")

find_knn_neighbors <- function(target_indices, feature_data, song_names, k = 5) {
  # This function finds the k-nearest neighbors for each target song
  all_recommendations <- data.frame()
  
  for(target_idx in target_indices) {
    # Create distance matrix from target to all other songs
    distances <- as.matrix(dist(feature_data))[target_idx, ]
    
    # Get indices of k+1 nearest neighbors (including the song itself)
    neighbor_indices <- order(distances)[1:(k + 1)]
    
    # Remove the song itself from neighbors
    neighbor_indices <- setdiff(neighbor_indices, target_idx)
    neighbor_indices <- neighbor_indices[1:k]  # Take top k
    
    # Create results
    song_recs <- data.frame(
      query_song = song_names[target_idx],
      recommended_song = song_names[neighbor_indices],
      distance = distances[neighbor_indices],
      rank = 1:length(neighbor_indices),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    all_recommendations <- bind_rows(all_recommendations, song_recs)
  }
  
  return(all_recommendations)
}

  cat("1. Adjust k value in KNN for more/fewer recommendations\n")
  cat("2. Add more features (tempo, energy, etc.) for better similarity\n")
  cat("3. Try different distance metrics (cosine, Manhattan, etc.)\n")
  
} else {
  cat("\n❌ No recommendations found. Possible issues:\n")
  cat("   1. Feature scaling might be incorrect\n")
  cat("   2. All TPAB songs might be identical in feature space\n")
  cat("   3. Check if feature matrix has valid values\n")
}
```

```{r}
# IMPROVED KNN WITH BETTER THEME OPERATIONALIZATION
library(dplyr)

# 1. IMPROVED FEATURE EXTRACTION WITH BETTER THEME OPERATIONALIZATION
cat("\nExtracting IMPROVED thematic features...\n")

extract_improved_thematic_features <- function(lyrics_text) {
  if (is.na(lyrics_text) || nchar(lyrics_text) < 10) {
    return(data.frame(
      sentiment_mean = 0,
      sentiment_volatility = 0,
      sentiment_range = 0,
      
      # IMPROVED THEME FEATURES - BROADER, MORE NUANCED
      theme_social_justice = 0,        # Social issues, power dynamics
      theme_personal_identity = 0,     # Self, identity, personal journey
      theme_spiritual_existential = 0, # Spiritual, philosophical, existential
      theme_material_ambition = 0,     # Money, success, ambition
      theme_struggle_pain = 0,         # Struggle, pain, hardship
      theme_celebration_joy = 0,       # Celebration, joy, triumph
      theme_urban_life = 0,            # Urban/city life experiences
      theme_relationships = 0,         # Relationships with others
      theme_defiance_resistance = 0,   # Defiance, resistance, rebellion
      theme_nostalgia_reflection = 0,  # Nostalgia, reflection, memory
      
      # TEXTUAL COMPLEXITY FEATURES
      lexical_diversity = 0,
      avg_sentence_length = 0,
      word_count = length(unlist(strsplit(tolower(lyrics_text), "\\W+")))
    ))
  }
  
  # Clean and prepare text
  text <- tolower(lyrics_text)
  words <- unlist(strsplit(text, "\\W+"))
  words <- words[words != ""]
  
  if(length(words) == 0) {
    return(extract_improved_thematic_features(""))  # Return zeros
  }
  
  # SENTIMENT ANALYSIS - MORE ROBUST
  # Positive words (expanded list)
  positive_words <- c("love", "happy", "joy", "peace", "hope", "beautiful", 
                      "great", "good", "excellent", "amazing", "wonderful",
                      "blessed", "strong", "powerful", "free", "alive",
                      "victory", "win", "success", "triumph", "celebrate",
                      "glory", "honor", "respect", "pride", "dope", "fire")
  
  # Negative words (expanded list)
  negative_words <- c("hate", "sad", "pain", "death", "die", "kill", "war",
                      "fight", "anger", "mad", "bad", "terrible", "horrible",
                      "suffer", "struggle", "poor", "broke", "hungry",
                      "oppression", "racism", "police", "violence", "crime",
                      "fear", "scared", "afraid", "anxiety", "stress")
  
  # Calculate sentiment
  positive_count <- sum(words %in% positive_words)
  negative_count <- sum(words %in% negative_words)
  total_sentiment_words <- positive_count + negative_count
  
  if(total_sentiment_words > 0) {
    sentiment_score <- (positive_count - negative_count) / total_sentiment_words
    sentiment_mean <- sentiment_score  # Normalized between -1 and 1
    sentiment_volatility <- 0  # Simplified for now
    sentiment_range <- ifelse(positive_count > 0 && negative_count > 0, 2, 1)
  } else {
    sentiment_mean <- sentiment_volatility <- sentiment_range <- 0
  }
  
  # IMPROVED THEME DETECTION - BROADER CATEGORIES WITH WEIGHTED SCORES
  # Each theme has primary and secondary keywords with different weights
  themes <- list(
    # Social justice theme - weighted by importance
    theme_social_justice = c(
      rep("oppression", 3), rep("power", 2), rep("racism", 3), 
      rep("police", 2), rep("justice", 3), rep("inequality", 3),
      rep("protest", 2), rep("black", 2), rep("white", 1), 
      rep("rights", 2), rep("freedom", 2), rep("equality", 3),
      rep("struggle", 2), rep("system", 2), rep("change", 1),
      rep("revolution", 3), rep("movement", 2), rep("community", 1)
    ),
    
    # Personal identity theme
    theme_personal_identity = c(
      rep("i", 1), rep("me", 1), rep("my", 1), rep("mine", 1), 
      rep("myself", 2), rep("self", 2), rep("i'm", 1), rep("i'll", 1),
      rep("identity", 3), rep("who", 1), rep("am", 1), rep("being", 1),
      rep("person", 1), rep("man", 1), rep("woman", 1), rep("human", 1),
      rep("soul", 2), rep("heart", 1), rep("mind", 1)
    ),
    
    # Spiritual/existential theme
    theme_spiritual_existential = c(
      rep("god", 3), rep("faith", 2), rep("pray", 2), rep("heaven", 2),
      rep("hell", 2), rep("sin", 2), rep("bless", 2), rep("soul", 2),
      rep("spirit", 2), rep("jesus", 3), rep("lord", 2), rep("church", 1),
      rep("bible", 1), rep("religious", 1), rep("believe", 1), rep("hope", 1),
      rep("life", 1), rep("death", 2), rep("afterlife", 2), rep("eternal", 2)
    ),
    
    # Material ambition theme
    theme_material_ambition = c(
      rep("money", 3), rep("cash", 3), rep("dollar", 2), rep("rich", 3),
      rep("wealth", 3), rep("gold", 2), rep("diamonds", 2), rep("expensive", 1),
      rep("cars", 2), rep("house", 1), rep("mansion", 2), rep("success", 2),
      rep("fame", 2), rep("power", 2), rep("boss", 1), rep("hustle", 2),
      rep("grind", 2), rep("work", 1), rep("paid", 2)
    ),
    
    # Struggle and pain theme
    theme_struggle_pain = c(
      rep("pain", 3), rep("hurt", 2), rep("suffer", 3), rep("struggle", 3),
      rep("fight", 2), rep("war", 2), rep("battle", 2), rep("hard", 1),
      rep("difficult", 1), rep("poor", 2), rep("broke", 2), rep("hungry", 2),
      rep("cold", 1), rep("alone", 2), rep("lonely", 2), rep("depressed", 3),
      rep("anxious", 2), rep("stress", 2), rep("pressure", 1)
    ),
    
    # Celebration and joy theme
    theme_celebration_joy = c(
      rep("celebrate", 2), rep("party", 2), rep("dance", 1), rep("happy", 2),
      rep("joy", 2), rep("fun", 1), rep("good", 1), rep("great", 1),
      rep("amazing", 1), rep("wonderful", 1), rep("beautiful", 1),
      rep("love", 2), rep("laugh", 1), rep("smile", 1), rep("win", 2),
      rep("success", 1), rep("victory", 2), rep("champ", 1), rep("king", 1)
    ),
    
    # Urban life theme
    theme_urban_life = c(
      rep("city", 2), rep("street", 2), rep("hood", 3), rep("block", 1),
      rep("corner", 1), rep("ghetto", 3), rep("project", 2), rep("urban", 1),
      rep("concrete", 1), rep("asphalt", 1), rep("alley", 1), rep("traffic", 1),
      rep("subway", 1), rep("bus", 1), rep("train", 1), rep("night", 1),
      rep("dark", 1), rep("noise", 1), rep("crowd", 1)
    ),
    
    # Relationships theme
    theme_relationships = c(
      rep("friend", 2), rep("family", 3), rep("mother", 2), rep("father", 2),
      rep("brother", 2), rep("sister", 2), rep("love", 2), rep("relationship", 2),
      rep("partner", 1), rep("wife", 2), rep("husband", 2), rep("girlfriend", 1),
      rep("boyfriend", 1), rep("together", 1), rep("connection", 2),
      rep("trust", 2), rep("loyal", 2), rep("betray", 2), rep("leave", 1)
    ),
    
    # Defiance and resistance theme
    theme_defiance_resistance = c(
      rep("fight", 2), rep("resist", 3), rep("defy", 3), rep("rebel", 3),
      rep("revolution", 3), rep("against", 1), rep("oppose", 2), rep("stand", 2),
      rep("strong", 1), rep("power", 1), rep("never", 1), rep("won't", 1),
      rep("can't", 1), rep("stop", 1), rep("fear", 1), rep("brave", 2),
      rep("courage", 2), rep("bold", 2), rep("dare", 2)
    ),
    
    # Nostalgia and reflection theme
    theme_nostalgia_reflection = c(
      rep("remember", 2), rep("memory", 2), rep("past", 2), rep("old", 1),
      rep("young", 1), rep("child", 1), rep("grow", 1), rep("change", 1),
      rep("time", 1), rep("years", 1), rep("ago", 1), rep("then", 1),
      rep("now", 1), rep("future", 1), rep("think", 1), rep("reflect", 2),
      rep("nostalgia", 3), rep("memory", 2), rep("dream", 1)
    )
  )
  
  # Calculate theme densities with weighting
  theme_densities <- sapply(themes, function(theme_words) {
    # Count occurrences with weights
    weighted_sum <- sum(sapply(words, function(word) {
      sum(theme_words == word)  # Weight is number of repetitions
    }))
    weighted_sum / (length(words) * max(as.numeric(names(table(theme_words))), na.rm = TRUE))
  })
  
  # TEXTUAL COMPLEXITY FEATURES
  lexical_diversity <- length(unique(words)) / length(words)
  
  # Estimate sentences (periods, line breaks, etc.)
  sentences <- unlist(strsplit(lyrics_text, "[.!?\\n]+"))
  avg_sentence_length <- ifelse(length(sentences) > 0, 
                                mean(nchar(sentences)), 
                                nchar(lyrics_text))
  
  return(data.frame(
    sentiment_mean = sentiment_mean,
    sentiment_volatility = sentiment_volatility,
    sentiment_range = sentiment_range,
    
    # Theme features
    theme_social_justice = theme_densities["theme_social_justice"],
    theme_personal_identity = theme_densities["theme_personal_identity"],
    theme_spiritual_existential = theme_densities["theme_spiritual_existential"],
    theme_material_ambition = theme_densities["theme_material_ambition"],
    theme_struggle_pain = theme_densities["theme_struggle_pain"],
    theme_celebration_joy = theme_densities["theme_celebration_joy"],
    theme_urban_life = theme_densities["theme_urban_life"],
    theme_relationships = theme_densities["theme_relationships"],
    theme_defiance_resistance = theme_densities["theme_defiance_resistance"],
    theme_nostalgia_reflection = theme_densities["theme_nostalgia_reflection"],
    
    # Text complexity
    lexical_diversity = lexical_diversity,
    avg_sentence_length = avg_sentence_length,
    word_count = length(words)
  ))
}

# Extract features for rap songs
cat("Extracting features for rap songs...\n")
rap_features <- do.call(rbind, lapply(rap_clean$lyrics, extract_improved_thematic_features))
rap_features$song_name <- rap_clean$song_name
rap_features$artist_name <- "Various Rap Artists"

# 2. Load and extract TPAB features with SAME function
cat("\nLoading and extracting TPAB features...\n")
tpab_features_original <- read.csv("D:/Coding - R/TPAB Music recs/scripts/data/processed/tpab_features_full.csv", 
                                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# We need the original TPAB lyrics to extract features with the improved function

if(file.exists("D:/Coding - R/TPAB Music recs/scripts/data/processed/tpab_raw_data.csv")) {
  tpab_raw <- read.csv("D:/Coding - R/TPAB Music recs/scripts/data/processed/tpab_raw_data.csv",

} else {
  # If we can't find the raw data, use the existing TPAB features and approximate

  tpab_tracks <- c("Wesley's Theory", "For Free?", "King Kunta", "Institutionalized",

# 3. COMBINE AND NORMALIZE - ENSURING KNN WILL WORK
cat("\nCombining and normalizing datasets...\n")

# Combine
all_features <- bind_rows(
  rap_features %>%
    select(artist_name, track_name = song_name, everything()),
  tpab_features %>%
    select(artist_name, track_name = song_name, everything())
)

# Remove any columns that are all NA
all_features <- all_features[, colSums(!is.na(all_features)) > 0]

# Select only numeric features for KNN
feature_columns <- setdiff(names(all_features), 
                          c("artist_name", "track_name", "song_name"))

# Convert to numeric matrix
feature_matrix <- as.matrix(all_features[, feature_columns])
feature_matrix[is.na(feature_matrix)] <- 0

# 4. CRITICAL: NORMALIZE PROPERLY FOR KNN
cat("Normalizing features...\n")

# Method 1: Min-Max scaling to [0, 1] range
normalize_minmax <- function(x) {
  if(max(x) == min(x)) return(rep(0.5, length(x)))
  (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x))
}

# Method 2: Z-score standardization
normalize_zscore <- function(x) {
  if(sd(x) == 0) return(rep(0, length(x)))
  (x - mean(x)) / sd(x)
}

# Apply normalization column-wise
feature_normalized <- apply(feature_matrix, 2, normalize_minmax)

# If any column becomes NA (all same values), set to 0.5
feature_normalized[is.na(feature_normalized)] <- 0.5

cat("Feature matrix dimensions:", dim(feature_normalized), "\n")

# 5. GUARANTEED KNN - ALWAYS FIND NEAREST NEIGHBORS
cat("\nRunning GUARANTEED KNN analysis...\n")

# Get TPAB indices
tpab_indices <- which(all_features$artist_name == "Kendrick Lamar")
rap_indices <- which(all_features$artist_name != "Kendrick Lamar")

cat("TPAB songs:", length(tpab_indices), "\n")
cat("Rap songs:", length(rap_indices), "\n")

# Create distance matrix
cat("Calculating distances...\n")

# Use Euclidean distance (standard for KNN)
distances <- matrix(0, nrow = length(tpab_indices), ncol = length(rap_indices))
rownames(distances) <- all_features$track_name[tpab_indices]
colnames(distances) <- all_features$track_name[rap_indices]

# Calculate all pairwise distances
for(i in 1:length(tpab_indices)) {
  for(j in 1:length(rap_indices)) {
    # Euclidean distance between normalized feature vectors
    dist <- sqrt(sum((feature_normalized[tpab_indices[i], ] - 
                      feature_normalized[rap_indices[j], ])^2))
    distances[i, j] <- dist
  }
  if(i %% 5 == 0) cat(sprintf("  Processed %d/%d TPAB songs\n", i, length(tpab_indices)))
}

# 6. FIND AND ANALYZE NEAREST NEIGHBORS
cat("\nFinding nearest neighbors...\n")

# For each TPAB song, find k nearest rap songs
k <- 10  # Increase k to get more recommendations
all_recommendations <- data.frame()

for(i in 1:nrow(distances)) {
  tpab_song <- rownames(distances)[i]
  
  # Get distances for this TPAB song
  song_distances <- distances[i, ]
  
  # Get indices of k nearest rap songs
  nearest_indices <- order(song_distances)[1:min(k, length(song_distances))]
  
  # Create recommendations
  recommendations <- data.frame(
    query_song = tpab_song,
    recommended_song = colnames(distances)[nearest_indices],
    distance = song_distances[nearest_indices],
    rank = 1:length(nearest_indices),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  all_recommendations <- bind_rows(all_recommendations, recommendations)
}

cat("\n✅ Found", nrow(all_recommendations), "recommendations total\n")

# 7. SAVE AND ANALYZE RESULTS
if(!dir.exists("outputs")) dir.create("outputs", recursive = TRUE)

# Save all recommendations
write.csv(all_recommendations, 
          "outputs/tpab_knn_improved_recommendations.csv", 
          row.names = FALSE)

# Analyze which rap songs are most frequently recommended
cat("\n=== MOST FREQUENTLY RECOMMENDED RAP SONGS ===\n")
top_recommended <- all_recommendations %>%
  group_by(recommended_song) %>%
  summarise(
    times_recommended = n(),
    avg_distance = mean(distance),
    min_distance = min(distance)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(times_recommended), avg_distance) %>%
  head(10)

print(top_recommended)

# 8. ANALYZE TPAB SONGS IN THE CONTEXT OF RAP LANDSCAPE
cat("\n=== TPAB SONGS IN RAP LANDSCAPE ===\n")

# For each TPAB song, calculate its "centrality" in rap landscape
tpab_analysis <- data.frame()

for(i in 1:length(tpab_indices)) {
  tpab_song <- all_features$track_name[tpab_indices[i]]
  
  # Get all distances from this TPAB song to rap songs
  tpab_to_rap_dist <- distances[i, ]
  
  # Calculate statistics
  stats <- data.frame(
    tpab_song = tpab_song,
    avg_distance_to_rap = mean(tpab_to_rap_dist),
    median_distance_to_rap = median(tpab_to_rap_dist),
    min_distance_to_rap = min(tpab_to_rap_dist),
    max_distance_to_rap = max(tpab_to_rap_dist),
    # Percentile in the distribution of distances
    percentile_25 = quantile(tpab_to_rap_dist, 0.25),
    percentile_75 = quantile(tpab_to_rap_dist, 0.75),
    # How "unique" is this song? (distance from centroid of rap songs)
    uniqueness_score = sd(tpab_to_rap_dist) / mean(tpab_to_rap_dist),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  tpab_analysis <- bind_rows(tpab_analysis, stats)
}

# Sort by average distance (closest to rap songs first)
tpab_analysis <- tpab_analysis %>%
  arrange(avg_distance_to_rap)

cat("\nTPAB songs ordered by similarity to average rap song:\n")
print(tpab_analysis[, 1:5])

# Save analysis
write.csv(tpab_analysis, "outputs/tpab_rap_landscape_analysis.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 9. CREATE VISUALIZATION OF DISTANCES
cat("\nCreating visualizations...\n")

# Heatmap of distances
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare data for heatmap
heatmap_data <- as.data.frame(distances)
heatmap_data$tpab_song <- rownames(distances)
heatmap_long <- heatmap_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -tpab_song, names_to = "rap_song", values_to = "distance") %>%
  group_by(tpab_song) %>%
  mutate(
    distance_rank = rank(distance),
    is_top_10 = distance_rank <= 10
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Create heatmap (sample of top rap songs for clarity)
top_rap_songs <- all_recommendations %>%
  group_by(recommended_song) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  head(20) %>%
  pull(recommended_song)

heatmap_filtered <- heatmap_long %>%
  filter(rap_song %in% top_rap_songs)

p <- ggplot(heatmap_filtered, aes(x = rap_song, y = tpab_song, fill = distance)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", 
                      midpoint = median(heatmap_filtered$distance)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)) +
  labs(title = "Distance Matrix: TPAB Songs vs Top Rap Songs",
       subtitle = "Blue = Closer (more similar), Red = Farther (less similar)",
       x = "Rap Songs", y = "TPAB Songs")

ggsave("outputs/distance_heatmap.png", p, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# 10. FINAL REPORT
cat("\n" , strrep("=", 70), "\n")
cat("IMPROVED KNN ANALYSIS COMPLETE\n")
cat(strrep("=", 70), "\n\n")

cat("KEY IMPROVEMENTS:\n")
cat("1. Better theme operationalization: 10 nuanced themes with weighted keywords\n")
cat("2. Guaranteed recommendations: Always finds k-nearest neighbors\n")
cat("3. Proper normalization: All features scaled to [0,1] range\n")
cat("4. Comprehensive analysis: Distance matrix + statistical analysis\n\n")

cat("RESULTS SUMMARY:\n")
cat(sprintf("1. Analyzed %d TPAB songs against %d rap songs\n", 
            length(tpab_indices), length(rap_indices)))
cat(sprintf("2. Generated %d total recommendations (k=%d per TPAB song)\n", 
            nrow(all_recommendations), k))
cat(sprintf("3. Most recommended rap song: %s (%d times)\n", 
            top_recommended$recommended_song[1], top_recommended$times_recommended[1]))
cat(sprintf("4. Most 'central' TPAB song: %s (avg distance: %.3f)\n",
            tpab_analysis$tpab_song[1], tpab_analysis$avg_distance_to_rap[1]))
cat(sprintf("5. Most 'unique' TPAB song: %s (avg distance: %.3f)\n",
            tpab_analysis$tpab_song[nrow(tpab_analysis)], 
            tpab_analysis$avg_distance_to_rap[nrow(tpab_analysis)]))

cat("\nFILES CREATED:\n")
cat("1. outputs/tpab_knn_improved_recommendations.csv - All KNN recommendations\n")
cat("2. outputs/tpab_rap_landscape_analysis.csv - Statistical analysis\n")
cat("3. outputs/distance_heatmap.png - Visualization of distances\n")

cat("\nINTERPRETATION:\n")
cat("- Distance = 0: Perfect match (identical feature vectors)\n")
cat("- Distance = 1: Maximum difference (opposite ends of feature space)\n")
cat("- Smaller distance = More thematically similar\n")
cat("- Larger distance = More thematically different\n")

cat("\nThe analysis shows where TPAB songs sit in the broader rap landscape.\n")
cat("Even if no rap song is 'close', we can still see which are 'closest'.\n")
cat("This helps understand TPAB's thematic uniqueness within rap music.\n")
```

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries

library(Rtsne)
library(ggplot2)     # For creating the visualizations
library(dplyr)       # For data manipulation
library(class)       # For KNN calculations

# 1. Prepare the Combined Feature Matrix
# Assuming 'all_features' is your combined dataframe of TPAB and rap song features
# and 'feature_columns' is the list of numeric feature names (e.g., sentiment_mean, theme_justice, etc.)

feature_matrix <- as.matrix(all_features[, feature_columns])
feature_matrix[is.na(feature_matrix)] <- 0 # Handle missing values

# Identify which rows are TPAB songs and which are rap songs for later coloring
is_tpab <- all_features$artist_name == "Kendrick Lamar"

# 2. Apply t-SNE to Create a 2D Map
# t-SNE projects our high-dimensional features onto 2 dimensions for visualization.
# Perplexity (~30) balances local/global structure; random_state ensures reproducibility[citation:1].
set.seed(123) # For reproducible t-SNE results
tsne_result <- Rtsne(feature_matrix, 
                     perplexity = 30, 
                     max_iter = 1000,
                     check_duplicates = FALSE)

# Create a dataframe for plotting
tsne_df <- data.frame(
  X = tsne_result$Y[, 1],
  Y = tsne_result$Y[, 2], 
  artist = all_features$artist_name,
  song = all_features$track_name,
  is_tpab = is_tpab
)

# 3. Calculate KNN Neighbors in the ORIGINAL High-Dimensional Space
# KNN classification happens here, based on Euclidean distance in the feature space.
k <- 5 # Number of nearest neighbors
tpab_indices <- which(is_tpab)
rap_indices <- which(!is_tpab)

# Calculate the k-nearest RAP song neighbors for EACH TPAB song
knn_neighbors <- knn(train = feature_matrix[rap_indices, ],
                     test = feature_matrix[tpab_indices, ],
                     cl = rap_indices, # We only need the indices of the rap songs
                     k = k,
                     prob = FALSE)

# 4. Prepare Data for Drawing Connection Lines
# We need to create a dataframe of line segments: from each TPAB point to each of its neighbors.
connections <- data.frame()

for (i in seq_along(tpab_indices)) {
  tpab_point <- tsne_df[tpab_indices[i], ]
  
  # Get the indices of the k-nearest rap song neighbors for this TPAB song
  neighbor_indices <- attr(knn_neighbors, "nn.index")[i, ]
  
  for (neighbor_idx in neighbor_indices) {
    # Get the actual row index in the original/tsne data for the neighbor
    actual_rap_row_index <- rap_indices[neighbor_idx]
    neighbor_point <- tsne_df[actual_rap_row_index, ]
    
    # Create a segment
    segment <- data.frame(
      x = tpab_point$X,
      y = tpab_point$Y,
      xend = neighbor_point$X,
      yend = neighbor_point$Y,
      query_song = tpab_point$song
    )
    connections <- rbind(connections, segment)
  }
}

library(ggrepel)



# Now create the KNN Visualization Plot
knn_plot <- ggplot() +
  # First, plot all songs as points
  geom_point(data = tsne_df, 
             aes(x = X, y = Y, color = artist, shape = is_tpab), 
             size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  
  # Overlay the KNN connection lines
  geom_segment(data = connections,
               aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend, group = query_song),
               color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.5) +
  
  # Highlight the TPAB songs (the "query points")
  geom_point(data = tsne_df[tsne_df$is_tpab, ],
             aes(x = X, y = Y), 
             color = "red", size = 4, shape = 1, stroke = 1.2) +
  
  # Add labels for TPAB songs to avoid clutter - USING ggrepel's function
  geom_text_repel(data = tsne_df[tsne_df$is_tpab, ],
                  aes(x = X, y = Y, label = song),
                  size = 3, box.padding = 0.5, max.overlaps = 15, color = "darkred") +
  
  # Styling
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Kendrick Lamar" = "red", "Various Rap Artists" = "blue")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 17, `FALSE` = 16), guide = "none") + # Triangle for TPAB
  labs(title = "K-Nearest Neighbors Visualization of TPAB in Rap Landscape",
       subtitle = "Red triangles: TPAB songs. Gray lines: connections to 5 nearest rap song neighbors.",
       x = "t-SNE Dimension 1",
       y = "t-SNE Dimension 2",
       color = "Artist") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Display the plot
print(knn_plot)

# Save the plot
if(!dir.exists("outputs")) dir.create("outputs", recursive = TRUE)
ggsave("outputs/knn_tpab_visualization.png", plot = knn_plot, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)

cat("\n✅ KNN visualization saved to: outputs/knn_tpab_visualization.png\n")
```

```{r}
# KNN CLASSIFICATION VISUALIZATION WITH MULTIPLE CLASSES

library(Rtsne)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(class)
library(ggrepel)
library(factoextra)  # For clustering visualization

# 1. Prepare the Combined Feature Matrix
feature_matrix <- as.matrix(all_features[, feature_columns])
feature_matrix[is.na(feature_matrix)] <- 0

# Identify TPAB songs
is_tpab <- all_features$artist_name == "Kendrick Lamar"
tpab_indices <- which(is_tpab)
rap_indices <- which(!is_tpab)

# 2. Apply t-SNE
set.seed(123)
tsne_result <- Rtsne(feature_matrix, 
                     perplexity = 30, 
                     max_iter = 1000,
                     check_duplicates = FALSE)

# 3. CREATE CLASSES FOR RAP SONGS USING K-MEANS CLUSTERING
# We'll cluster rap songs into distinct thematic groups that will serve as "classes"
cat("Creating thematic classes for rap songs using k-means clustering...\n")

# Determine optimal number of clusters using elbow method
set.seed(123)
wss <- sapply(1:10, function(k) {
  kmeans(feature_matrix[rap_indices, ], centers = k, nstart = 25)$tot.withinss
})

# Plot elbow curve
elbow_data <- data.frame(k = 1:10, wss = wss)
elbow_plot <- ggplot(elbow_data, aes(x = k, y = wss)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Elbow Method for Optimal k",
       x = "Number of Clusters (k)",
       y = "Total Within-Cluster Sum of Squares") +
  theme_minimal()

# Choose number of clusters (typically where elbow bends)
optimal_k <- 4  # You can adjust this based on elbow plot
cat(sprintf("Using k = %d clusters for rap song classification\n", optimal_k))

# Perform k-means clustering on rap songs
set.seed(123)
kmeans_result <- kmeans(feature_matrix[rap_indices, ], centers = optimal_k, nstart = 25)

# Assign cluster labels to rap songs
cluster_labels <- kmeans_result$cluster

# 4. CLASSIFY TPAB SONGS USING KNN
# Now we use KNN to classify TPAB songs based on the cluster labels of their nearest rap song neighbors
k <- 5  # Number of neighbors for KNN

cat("\nClassifying TPAB songs using KNN...\n")
tpab_classifications <- knn(
  train = feature_matrix[rap_indices, ],  # Training: rap songs
  test = feature_matrix[tpab_indices, ],  # Testing: TPAB songs
  cl = factor(cluster_labels),           # Class labels from clustering
  k = k,
  prob = TRUE
)

# Get classification confidence
classification_probs <- attr(tpab_classifications, "prob")

# 5. CREATE ENHANCED DATAFRAME WITH CLASS INFORMATION
tsne_df <- data.frame(
  X = tsne_result$Y[, 1],
  Y = tsne_result$Y[, 2],
  artist = all_features$artist_name,
  song = all_features$track_name,
  is_tpab = is_tpab,
  
  # Add class information
  class = ifelse(is_tpab, 
                 as.numeric(as.character(tpab_classifications)),  # TPAB: predicted class
                 cluster_labels[rap_indices]),                     # Rap: original cluster
  
  # Add classification confidence for TPAB songs
  confidence = ifelse(is_tpab, classification_probs, NA),
  
  # Create readable class names
  class_name = ifelse(is_tpab,
                      paste("Class", as.numeric(as.character(tpab_classifications)), 
                            "(TPAB)"),
                      paste("Class", cluster_labels[rap_indices], "(Rap)")
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# 6. CREATE MEANINGFUL CLASS NAMES BASED ON CLUSTER CHARACTERISTICS
# Analyze each cluster's feature profile to assign meaningful names
cat("\nAnalyzing cluster characteristics...\n")
cluster_centers <- kmeans_result$centers

# Assign thematic names based on cluster centers
# ROBUST CLUSTER NAMING FUNCTION
name_clusters_based_on_features <- function(cluster_centers, feature_matrix) {
  cluster_names <- c()
  
  for(i in 1:nrow(cluster_centers)) {
    center <- cluster_centers[i, ]
    
    # Initialize with cluster number
    proposed_name <- paste("Cluster", i)
    
    # Analyze the top 3 strongest features for this cluster
    top_features <- names(sort(center, decreasing = TRUE))[1:3]
    top_values <- sort(center, decreasing = TRUE)[1:3]
    
    # Feature name mapping for common themes
    feature_map <- list(
      social_justice = c("theme_social_justice", "theme_justice", "oppression", "justice"),
      material = c("theme_material_ambition", "theme_money", "money", "wealth"),
      spiritual = c("theme_spiritual_existential", "theme_spirituality", "god", "spirit"),
      personal = c("theme_personal_identity", "theme_self", "self", "identity"),
      struggle = c("theme_struggle_pain", "pain", "struggle", "suffer"),
      celebration = c("theme_celebration_joy", "celebration", "joy", "happy"),
      urban = c("theme_urban_life", "urban", "city", "street"),
      relationships = c("theme_relationships", "relationship", "love", "friend"),
      defiance = c("theme_defiance_resistance", "defiance", "resist", "fight"),
      nostalgia = c("theme_nostalgia_reflection", "nostalgia", "memory", "past")
    )
    
    # Check which category this cluster belongs to
    category_scores <- c()
    for(category_name in names(feature_map)) {
      # Find matching features
      matching_features <- intersect(feature_map[[category_name]], top_features)
      if(length(matching_features) > 0) {
        # Calculate average score for this category
        category_score <- mean(center[matching_features], na.rm = TRUE)
        category_scores[category_name] <- category_score
      }
    }
    
    # If we found meaningful categories
    if(length(category_scores) > 0) {
      # Get the strongest category
      strongest_category <- names(which.max(category_scores))
      category_strength <- max(category_scores, na.rm = TRUE)
      
      # Map category to readable name
      category_names <- c(
        social_justice = "Social Justice",
        material = "Material Ambition",
        spiritual = "Spiritual/Existential",
        personal = "Personal Identity",
        struggle = "Struggle/Pain",
        celebration = "Celebration/Joy",
        urban = "Urban Life",
        relationships = "Relationships",
        defiance = "Defiance/Resistance",
        nostalgia = "Nostalgia/Reflection"
      )
      
      if(strongest_category %in% names(category_names) && category_strength > 0.2) {
        proposed_name <- category_names[strongest_category]
        
        # Add strength indicator
        if(category_strength > 0.4) {
          proposed_name <- paste("Strong", proposed_name)
        } else if(category_strength > 0.25) {
          proposed_name <- paste("Moderate", proposed_name)
        } else {
          proposed_name <- paste("Mild", proposed_name)
        }
      }
    }
    
    cluster_names[i] <- proposed_name
  }
  
  return(cluster_names)
}

# Use the robust function
cluster_names <- name_clusters_based_on_features(kmeans_result$centers, feature_matrix)

cat("\nCluster names assigned:\n")
print(cluster_names)
# Update class names with meaningful labels
tsne_df$class_label <- ifelse(tsne_df$is_tpab,
                              paste(cluster_names[tsne_df$class], "(TPAB)"),
                              paste(cluster_names[tsne_df$class], "(Rap)"))

# 7. CREATE CONNECTION LINES FOR VISUALIZATION
connections <- data.frame()

for (i in seq_along(tpab_indices)) {
  tpab_idx <- tpab_indices[i]
  
  # Calculate distances from this TPAB song to all rap songs
  distances <- sqrt(rowSums((sweep(feature_matrix[rap_indices, ], 2, 
                                   feature_matrix[tpab_idx, ], "-"))^2))
  
  # Get indices of k nearest rap songs
  nearest_indices <- order(distances)[1:k]
  
  for (j in nearest_indices) {
    rap_idx <- rap_indices[j]
    
    connections <- rbind(connections, data.frame(
      x = tsne_df$X[tpab_idx],
      y = tsne_df$Y[tpab_idx],
      xend = tsne_df$X[rap_idx],
      yend = tsne_df$Y[rap_idx],
      tpab_song = tsne_df$song[tpab_idx],
      tpab_class = tsne_df$class[tpab_idx],
      rap_class = tsne_df$class[rap_idx],
      distance = distances[j],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
}

# 8. CREATE THE KNN CLASSIFICATION VISUALIZATION
# Define a color palette for the classes
class_palette <- c("#E41A1C", "#377EB8", "#4DAF4A", "#984EA3", 
                   "#FF7F00", "#FFFF33", "#A65628", "#F781BF")

# Main plot: TPAB classification in context of rap classes
knn_classification_plot <- ggplot() +
  # Plot rap songs as small points, colored by class
  geom_point(data = tsne_df[!tsne_df$is_tpab, ],
             aes(x = X, y = Y, color = factor(class)),
             size = 2, alpha = 0.5, shape = 16) +
  
  # Plot TPAB songs as larger points, colored by their predicted class
  geom_point(data = tsne_df[tsne_df$is_tpab, ],
             aes(x = X, y = Y, color = factor(class), size = confidence),
             shape = 17, alpha = 0.9) +
  
  # Add KNN connection lines (colored by TPAB class)
  geom_segment(data = connections,
               aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend, 
                   color = factor(tpab_class)),
               linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.4) +
  
  # Add labels for TPAB songs
  geom_text_repel(data = tsne_df[tsne_df$is_tpab, ],
                  aes(x = X, y = Y, label = gsub("Kendrick Lamar - ", "", song)),
                  size = 3.5, fontface = "bold",
                  box.padding = 0.5, max.overlaps = 20) +
  
  # Use the defined color palette
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Thematic Class",
    values = class_palette[1:optimal_k],
    labels = cluster_names[1:optimal_k]
  ) +
  
  # Size scale for confidence
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = "Classification Confidence",
    range = c(3, 6),
    limits = c(0.5, 1)
  ) +
  
  # Labels and titles
  labs(
    title = "KNN Classification: TPAB Songs in Rap Thematic Landscape",
    subtitle = paste("Colors = Thematic classes | Lines = KNN connections (k =", k, 
                     ") | Triangle size = Classification confidence"),
    x = "t-SNE Dimension 1",
    y = "t-SNE Dimension 2",
    caption = paste("Euclidean distance |", optimal_k, "thematic classes identified via k-means")
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray40", size = 11),
    legend.box = "vertical"
  )

# 9. CREATE A CLASSIFICATION RESULTS TABLE
cat("\n" , strrep("=", 70), "\n")
cat("KNN CLASSIFICATION RESULTS\n")
cat(strrep("=", 70), "\n\n")

classification_summary <- tsne_df[tsne_df$is_tpab, ] %>%
  arrange(class) %>%
  select(song, class_label, confidence) %>%
  rename(
    `TPAB Song` = song,
    `Predicted Class` = class_label,
    `Confidence` = confidence
  )

print(classification_summary)

# 10. CREATE ADDITIONAL VISUALIZATION: CLASS DISTRIBUTION
class_distribution <- tsne_df %>%
  group_by(is_tpab, class) %>%
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = ifelse(is_tpab, "TPAB Songs", "Rap Songs"),
    class_name = cluster_names[class]
  )

distribution_plot <- ggplot(class_distribution, 
                            aes(x = factor(class_name), y = count, fill = group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TPAB Songs" = "#E41A1C", "Rap Songs" = "#377EB8")) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Songs Across Thematic Classes",
    subtitle = "Comparison between TPAB classification and rap song clustering",
    x = "Thematic Class",
    y = "Number of Songs",
    fill = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# 11. SAVE ALL VISUALIZATIONS
if(!dir.exists("outputs")) dir.create("outputs", recursive = TRUE)

ggsave("outputs/knn_classification_visualization.png", 
       plot = knn_classification_plot, 
       width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)

ggsave("outputs/elbow_method_clusters.png", 
       plot = elbow_plot, 
       width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

ggsave("outputs/class_distribution.png", 
       plot = distribution_plot, 
       width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# Save classification results
write.csv(classification_summary, 
          "outputs/tpab_classification_results.csv", 
          row.names = FALSE)

# 12. DISPLAY RESULTS
cat("\n")
print(knn_classification_plot)

cat("\n" , strrep("=", 70), "\n")
cat("VISUALIZATION KEY\n")
cat(strrep("=", 70), "\n")
cat("1. COLORS represent DIFFERENT THEMATIC CLASSES\n")
cat("   - Each color = A distinct thematic profile identified via k-means\n")
cat("2. SMALL BLUE DOTS = Rap songs (colored by their natural cluster)\n")
cat("3. COLORED TRIANGLES = TPAB songs (colored by their KNN-predicted class)\n")
cat("4. LINES connect each TPAB song to its k-nearest rap song neighbors\n")
cat("5. TRIANGLE SIZE = Classification confidence (larger = more confident)\n\n")

cat("INTERPRETATION:\n")
cat("- TPAB songs are CLASSIFIED based on majority vote of their nearest neighbors\n")
cat("- Each TPAB song is assigned to the MOST COMMON class among its neighbors\n")
cat("- Confidence = proportion of neighbors that agree with the classification\n")
cat("- This is TRUE KNN CLASSIFICATION, not just similarity search!\n")

cat("\n✅ Files saved:\n")
cat("   1. outputs/knn_classification_visualization.png - Main KNN classification plot\n")
cat("   2. outputs/elbow_method_clusters.png - Elbow method for determining k\n")
cat("   3. outputs/class_distribution.png - Class distribution comparison\n")
cat("   4. outputs/tpab_classification_results.csv - Classification table\n")
```
