```{r}
# ======================================================================
# COMPLETE ENHANCED KNN-THEMATIC ANALYSIS FOR TPAB - CORRECTED ORDER
# ======================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(class)
library(Rtsne)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(factoextra)
library(knitr)
library(tidytext)

# ======================================================================
# STEP 1: LOAD AND PREPARE YOUR DATA
# ======================================================================

# Load your features (adjust path as needed)
features <- read.csv("D:/Coding - R/TPAB Music recs/scripts/data/processed/tpab_features_full.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Load your rap songs dataset (you need this for the broader rap context)
# Assuming you have a file with other rap songs
# If not, create a dummy dataset for demonstration
if (!exists("rap_features")) {
  # Create a synthetic rap songs dataset for demonstration
  set.seed(123)
  n_rap_songs <- 100
  
  rap_features <- data.frame(
    track_name = paste0("RapSong_", 1:n_rap_songs),
    artist_name = sample(c("Various Rap Artists", "Other Rappers"), n_rap_songs, replace = TRUE),
    duration_ms = runif(n_rap_songs, 120000, 300000),
    popularity = sample(30:90, n_rap_songs, replace = TRUE),
    speechiness = runif(n_rap_songs, 0.1, 0.9),
    danceability = runif(n_rap_songs, 0.1, 0.9),
    tempo = runif(n_rap_songs, 60, 180),
    sentiment_mean = runif(n_rap_songs, -1, 1),
    sentiment_volatility = runif(n_rap_songs, 0, 2),
    sentiment_range = runif(n_rap_songs, 0, 6),
    theme_justice = runif(n_rap_songs, 0, 0.3),
    theme_self = runif(n_rap_songs, 0.05, 0.4),
    theme_spirituality = runif(n_rap_songs, 0, 0.2),
    theme_money = runif(n_rap_songs, 0, 0.3),
    word_count = sample(200:5000, n_rap_songs, replace = TRUE),
    lexical_diversity = runif(n_rap_songs, 0.2, 0.5),
    avg_word_length = runif(n_rap_songs, 4, 8),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Combine TPAB and rap songs
features$artist_name <- "Kendrick Lamar"
all_features <- bind_rows(
  features %>% mutate(album = "To Pimp a Butterfly"),
  rap_features %>% mutate(album = "Other Rap")
)

# ======================================================================
# STEP 2: PREPARE FEATURE MATRIX
# ======================================================================

# Define feature columns (make sure these match your actual column names)
feature_columns <- c(
  "duration_ms", "popularity", "speechiness", "danceability", 
  "tempo", "sentiment_mean", "sentiment_volatility", 
  "sentiment_range", "theme_justice", "theme_self", 
  "theme_spirituality", "theme_money"
)

# Check which columns actually exist
existing_cols <- feature_columns[feature_columns %in% colnames(all_features)]
cat("Using features:", paste(existing_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Create feature matrix
feature_matrix <- as.matrix(all_features[, existing_cols])
feature_matrix[is.na(feature_matrix)] <- 0

# Scale features
scaler <- preProcess(feature_matrix, method = c("center", "scale"))
feature_scaled <- predict(scaler, feature_matrix)

# ======================================================================
# STEP 3: IDENTIFY TPAB AND RAP INDICES
# ======================================================================

is_tpab <- all_features$artist_name == "Kendrick Lamar"
tpab_indices <- which(is_tpab)
rap_indices <- which(!is_tpab)

cat("TPAB songs:", length(tpab_indices), "\n")
cat("Rap songs:", length(rap_indices), "\n")

# ======================================================================
# STEP 4: K-MEANS CLUSTERING ON RAP SONGS
# ======================================================================

# Determine optimal number of clusters
set.seed(123)
optimal_k <- 4  # You can adjust based on elbow method
cat("Using k =", optimal_k, "clusters for k-means\n")

# Perform k-means on rap songs only
kmeans_result <- kmeans(feature_scaled[rap_indices, ], centers = optimal_k, nstart = 25)
cluster_labels <- kmeans_result$cluster

# ======================================================================
# CORRECTED STEP 5: KNN WITH PROPER NOISE INJECTION
# ======================================================================

k <- 5  # Number of neighbors for KNN

# Get dimensions of training data
train_rows <- nrow(feature_scaled[rap_indices, ])
train_cols <- ncol(feature_scaled[rap_indices, ])

cat("Training data dimensions:", train_rows, "x", train_cols, "\n")

# Add tiny random noise with CORRECT dimensions
set.seed(123)
tiny_noise <- matrix(
  rnorm(train_rows * train_cols, mean = 0, sd = 1e-5),  # Very small standard deviation
  nrow = train_rows,
  ncol = train_cols
)

# Apply noise only to training data (rap songs)
train_data <- feature_scaled[rap_indices, ] + tiny_noise
test_data <- feature_scaled[tpab_indices, ]

# Classify TPAB songs using KNN with noise
tpab_classifications <- knn(
  train = train_data,
  test = test_data,
  cl = factor(cluster_labels),
  k = k,
  prob = TRUE
)

classification_probs <- attr(tpab_classifications, "prob")

cat("KNN classification successful with noise injection\n")
cat("Number of TPAB songs classified:", length(tpab_classifications), "\n")

# ======================================================================
# STEP 6: t-SNE VISUALIZATION
# ======================================================================

set.seed(123)
tsne_result <- Rtsne(feature_scaled, perplexity = 30, max_iter = 1000, check_duplicates = FALSE)

# ======================================================================
# STEP 7: CREATE TSNE_DF WITH BASIC INFORMATION
# ======================================================================

tsne_df <- data.frame(
  X = tsne_result$Y[, 1],
  Y = tsne_result$Y[, 2],
  artist = all_features$artist_name,
  song = all_features$track_name,
  is_tpab = is_tpab,
  class = ifelse(is_tpab, 
                 as.numeric(as.character(tpab_classifications)),
                 cluster_labels[rap_indices]),
  confidence = ifelse(is_tpab, classification_probs, NA),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ======================================================================
# STEP 8: CREATE CLUSTER NAMES (NEW FUNCTION)
# ======================================================================

# Function to name clusters based on their characteristics
name_clusters_directly <- function(kmeans_result, optimal_k) {
  cluster_names <- character(optimal_k)
  
  for (i in 1:optimal_k) {
    # Get the center for this cluster
    center <- kmeans_result$centers[i, ]
    
    # Find the strongest features
    sorted_features <- sort(center, decreasing = TRUE)
    top_features <- names(sorted_features)[1:3]
    
    # Map features to themes
    theme_scores <- c(
      social_justice = mean(center[c("theme_justice", "sentiment_range")], na.rm = TRUE),
      personal = mean(center[c("theme_self", "sentiment_mean")], na.rm = TRUE),
      material = mean(center[c("theme_money")], na.rm = TRUE),
      spiritual = mean(center[c("theme_spirituality")], na.rm = TRUE),
      emotional = mean(center[c("sentiment_volatility", "sentiment_range")], na.rm = TRUE),
      musical = mean(center[c("danceability", "tempo", "speechiness")], na.rm = TRUE)
    )
    
    # Get the dominant theme
    dominant_theme <- names(which.max(theme_scores))
    dominant_score <- max(theme_scores)
    
    # Create name based on dominant theme
    if (dominant_score > 0.5) {
      prefix <- "Strong"
    } else if (dominant_score > 0.2) {
      prefix <- "Moderate"
    } else {
      prefix <- "Mixed"
    }
    
    # Map theme codes to readable names
    theme_names <- c(
      social_justice = "Social Justice",
      personal = "Personal/Identity",
      material = "Material/Ambition",
      spiritual = "Spiritual/Existential",
      emotional = "Emotional/Volatile",
      musical = "Musical/Danceable"
    )
    
    cluster_names[i] <- paste(prefix, theme_names[dominant_theme])
  }
  
  return(cluster_names)
}

# Generate cluster names
cluster_names <- name_clusters_directly(kmeans_result, optimal_k)
cat("\nCluster names:\n")
print(data.frame(Cluster = 1:optimal_k, Name = cluster_names))

# Update tsne_df with cluster names
tsne_df$class_label <- ifelse(tsne_df$is_tpab,
                              paste(cluster_names[tsne_df$class], "(TPAB)"),
                              paste(cluster_names[tsne_df$class], "(Rap)"))

# ======================================================================
# STEP 9: CREATE CONNECTIONS (FIXED VERSION)
# ======================================================================

connections <- data.frame()

for (i in seq_along(tpab_indices)) {
  tpab_idx <- tpab_indices[i]
  
  # Calculate distances from this TPAB song to all rap songs
  distances <- sqrt(rowSums((sweep(feature_scaled[rap_indices, ], 2, 
                                   feature_scaled[tpab_idx, ], "-"))^2))
  
  # Get indices of k nearest rap songs
  nearest_indices <- order(distances)[1:k]
  
  for (j in nearest_indices) {
    rap_idx <- rap_indices[j]
    
    connections <- rbind(connections, data.frame(
      x = tsne_df$X[tpab_idx],
      y = tsne_df$Y[tpab_idx],
      xend = tsne_df$X[rap_idx],
      yend = tsne_df$Y[rap_idx],
      tpab_song = tsne_df$song[tpab_idx],
      tpab_class = tsne_df$class[tpab_idx],
      rap_class = tsne_df$class[rap_idx],
      distance = distances[j],
      rap_song = tsne_df$song[rap_idx],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
}

# ======================================================================
# STEP 10: CREATE CONNECTIONS_LABELED (SIMPLIFIED VERSION)
# ======================================================================

# Create simpler connections_labeled
connections_labeled <- data.frame(
  x = connections$x,
  y = connections$y,
  xend = connections$xend,
  yend = connections$yend,
  tpab_song = connections$tpab_song,
  rap_song = connections$rap_song,
  tpab_class = connections$tpab_class,
  rap_class = connections$rap_class,
  distance = connections$distance,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Add TPAB confidence
tpab_conf <- tsne_df %>% 
  filter(is_tpab) %>% 
  select(song, confidence) %>%
  rename(tpab_confidence = confidence)

connections_labeled <- connections_labeled %>%
  left_join(tpab_conf, by = c("tpab_song" = "song")) %>%
  mutate(
    tpab_song_clean = gsub("Kendrick Lamar - ", "", tpab_song),
    rap_song_clean = gsub("Various Rap Artists - ", "", rap_song)
  )

cat("\nCreated connections_labeled with", nrow(connections_labeled), "connections\n")
print(head(connections_labeled, 3))

# ======================================================================
# STEP 11: CREATE ENHANCED PLOT (SIMPLIFIED VERSION)
# ======================================================================

create_simple_knn_plot <- function(tsne_df, connections_labeled, cluster_names, optimal_k) {
  
  # Color palette
  thematic_palette <- c("#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e", "#2ca02c", "#d62728",
                       "#9467bd", "#8c564b", "#e377c2", "#7f7f7f")
  
  # Main plot
  plot <- ggplot() +
    # Rap songs as background
    geom_point(data = tsne_df[!tsne_df$is_tpab, ],
               aes(x = X, y = Y, color = factor(class)),
               size = 2, alpha = 0.4, shape = 16) +
    
    # TPAB songs
    geom_point(data = tsne_df[tsne_df$is_tpab, ],
               aes(x = X, y = Y, fill = factor(class), size = confidence),
               shape = 23, color = "black", stroke = 0.8) +
    
    # KNN connections
    geom_segment(data = connections_labeled,
                 aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend,
                     color = factor(tpab_class)),
                 alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 0.4) +
    
    # TPAB labels
    geom_text_repel(data = tsne_df[tsne_df$is_tpab, ],
                    aes(x = X, y = Y, 
                        label = gsub("Kendrick Lamar - ", "", song)),
                    size = 3.2, fontface = "bold",
                    box.padding = 0.5, point.padding = 0.3) +
    
    # Color scales
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "Thematic Clusters",
      values = thematic_palette[1:optimal_k],
      labels = cluster_names
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = "TPAB Classification",
      values = thematic_palette[1:optimal_k],
      labels = cluster_names,
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      name = "KNN Confidence",
      range = c(3, 7)
    ) +
    
    # Labels
    labs(
      title = "KNN Classification: TPAB Songs in Rap Thematic Landscape",
      subtitle = paste("Colors =", optimal_k, "thematic clusters | Lines = KNN connections (k =", k, ")"),
      x = "t-SNE Dimension 1",
      y = "t-SNE Dimension 2",
      caption = "TPAB songs classified by their nearest rap song neighbors"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
  
  return(plot)
}

# ======================================================================
# STEP 12: GENERATE AND SAVE THE PLOT
# ======================================================================

# Create the plot
enhanced_plot <- create_simple_knn_plot(tsne_df, connections_labeled, cluster_names, optimal_k)

# Display the plot
print(enhanced_plot)

# Save outputs
if(!dir.exists("outputs")) {
  dir.create("outputs", recursive = TRUE)
}

# Save the plot
ggsave("outputs/enhanced_knn_classification.png", 
       plot = enhanced_plot, 
       width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)

# ======================================================================
# STEP 13: GENERATE ANALYSIS REPORT
# ======================================================================

cat("\n", strrep("=", 80), "\n")
cat("THEMATIC ANALYSIS REPORT\n")
cat(strrep("=", 80), "\n\n")

# Cluster analysis
cat("1. CLUSTER CHARACTERISTICS:\n")
cat(strrep("-", 40), "\n")
for(i in 1:optimal_k) {
  cat(sprintf("Cluster %d: %s\n", i, cluster_names[i]))
  cat(sprintf("  Size: %d rap songs\n", sum(kmeans_result$cluster == i)))
  
  # Get average feature values for this cluster
  cluster_data <- feature_scaled[rap_indices, ][kmeans_result$cluster == i, ]
  if(nrow(cluster_data) > 0) {
    avg_features <- colMeans(cluster_data, na.rm = TRUE)
    top_features <- names(sort(avg_features, decreasing = TRUE))[1:3]
    cat(sprintf("  Key features: %s\n", paste(top_features, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  cat("\n")
}

# TPAB classification results
cat("\n2. TPAB SONG CLASSIFICATIONS:\n")
cat(strrep("-", 40), "\n")
tpab_results <- tsne_df[tsne_df$is_tpab, ] %>%
  arrange(class) %>%
  select(song, class_label, confidence) %>%
  mutate(
    song_clean = gsub("Kendrick Lamar - ", "", song),
    confidence_level = ifelse(confidence > 0.8, "High",
                              ifelse(confidence > 0.6, "Medium", "Low"))
  )

print(tpab_results %>% select(song_clean, class_label, confidence_level))

# KNN connections summary
cat("\n3. KNN CONNECTIONS SUMMARY:\n")
cat(strrep("-", 40), "\n")
connections_summary <- connections_labeled %>%
  group_by(tpab_song_clean, tpab_class) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_distance = mean(distance),
    num_connections = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(tpab_class, avg_distance)

print(connections_summary)

# ======================================================================
# STEP 14: SAVE ALL DATA
# ======================================================================

# Save cluster info
cluster_info <- data.frame(
  cluster_id = 1:optimal_k,
  cluster_name = cluster_names,
  size = sapply(1:optimal_k, function(i) sum(kmeans_result$cluster == i)),
  kmeans_result$centers
)
write.csv(cluster_info, "outputs/cluster_analysis.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Save TPAB classifications
write.csv(tpab_results, "outputs/tpab_classifications.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Save connections data
write.csv(connections_labeled, "outputs/knn_connections.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Save tsne data
write.csv(tsne_df, "outputs/tsne_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n✅ Analysis complete!\n")
cat("Files saved in 'outputs/' directory:\n")
cat("  1. enhanced_knn_classification.png - Main visualization\n")
cat("  2. cluster_analysis.csv - Cluster statistics\n")
cat("  3. tpab_classifications.csv - TPAB song classifications\n")
cat("  4. knn_connections.csv - KNN connection details\n")
cat("  5. tsne_data.csv - t-SNE coordinates\n")
```

```{r}
                   aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = 0, yend = 0))

    ) +

      legend.position = "right"
    )
  
  return(plot)
}

# Create the plot without connections
direct_plot <- create_direct_knn_plot(tsne_df, optimal_k, k, cluster_names)
print(direct_plot)

# Save it
if(!dir.exists("outputs")) dir.create("outputs")
ggsave("outputs/knn_classification_simple.png", plot = direct_plot, 
       width = 12, height = 9, dpi = 300)

cat("\n✅ Created simplified plot: outputs/knn_classification_simple.png\n")
```

```{r}
# ======================================================================
# COMPLETE REVISED KNN-THEMATIC ANALYSIS
# ======================================================================

library(Rtsne)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(factoextra)
library(caret)  # For robust KNN

# 1. PREPARE FEATURE MATRIX
feature_matrix <- as.matrix(all_features[, feature_columns])
feature_matrix[is.na(feature_matrix)] <- 0

# Identify TPAB songs
is_tpab <- all_features$artist_name == "Kendrick Lamar"
tpab_indices <- which(is_tpab)
rap_indices <- which(!is_tpab)

# 2. t-SNE FOR VISUALIZATION
set.seed(123)
tsne_result <- Rtsne(feature_matrix, perplexity = 30, max_iter = 1000, check_duplicates = FALSE)

# 3. K-MEANS CLUSTERING (UNSUPERVISED - creates the thematic classes)
cat("Step 1: Creating thematic classes using k-means clustering...\n")

# Determine optimal k using elbow method
set.seed(123)
wss <- sapply(1:10, function(k) {
  kmeans(feature_matrix[rap_indices, ], centers = k, nstart = 25)$tot.withinss
})

optimal_k <- 4
cat(sprintf("Using k = %d clusters for rap song classification\n", optimal_k))

# Perform k-means on rap songs only
set.seed(123)
kmeans_result <- kmeans(feature_matrix[rap_indices, ], centers = optimal_k, nstart = 25)
cluster_labels <- kmeans_result$cluster

# 4. KNN CLASSIFICATION (SUPERVISED - classifies TPAB songs)
cat("\nStep 2: Classifying TPAB songs using K-Nearest Neighbors...\n")
cat("Method: For each TPAB song, find its 5 nearest rap song neighbors\n")
cat("        Assign TPAB song to the most common cluster among those neighbors\n")

# ======================================================================
# DEFINITIVE SOLUTION - SIMPLE KNN WITHOUT CROSS-VALIDATION
# ======================================================================
# EVEN SIMPLER - USE BASIC KNN WITH NO FANCY STUFF
k <- 5

# Just run it
result <- try(
  knn(
    train = feature_matrix[rap_indices, ],
    test = feature_matrix[tpab_indices, ],
    cl = factor(cluster_labels),
    k = k,
    prob = TRUE
  ),
  silent = TRUE
)

# If it fails, use a simple alternative
if (inherits(result, "try-error")) {
  cat("KNN failed. Using simple assignment to nearest cluster center...\n")
  
  # Get cluster centers
  centers <- kmeans_result$centers
  
  # For each TPAB song, find closest cluster center
  tpab_predictions <- numeric(length(tpab_indices))
  classification_probs <- numeric(length(tpab_indices))
  
  for (i in 1:length(tpab_indices)) {
    distances <- sqrt(rowSums((sweep(centers, 2, 
                                     feature_matrix[tpab_indices[i], ], "-"))^2))
    tpab_predictions[i] <- which.min(distances)
    classification_probs[i] <- 1 - (min(distances) / max(distances))
  }
} else {
  tpab_predictions <- result
  classification_probs <- attr(result, "prob")
}

cat("Done!\n")
# 5. CREATE ENHANCED DATAFRAME
cat("\nStep 3: Creating visualization dataframe...\n")

# Simple cluster naming
cluster_names <- c(
  "Social Justice Focus",
  "Personal Identity/Narrative", 
  "Material Ambition",
  "Spiritual/Existential"
)

tsne_df <- data.frame(
  X = tsne_result$Y[, 1],
  Y = tsne_result$Y[, 2],
  artist = all_features$artist_name,
  song = all_features$track_name,
  is_tpab = is_tpab,
  class = ifelse(is_tpab, tpab_classifications, cluster_labels[rap_indices]),
  confidence = ifelse(is_tpab, classification_probs, NA),
  cluster_name = ifelse(is_tpab, 
                       cluster_names[tpab_classifications],
                       cluster_names[cluster_labels[rap_indices]]),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# 6. CREATE KNN CONNECTIONS (What connects to what)
cat("\nStep 4: Creating KNN connection lines...\n")
cat("Each TPAB song connects to its 5 nearest rap song neighbors\n")

# Function to find nearest neighbors
find_k_neighbors <- function(test_point, train_data, k_value) {
  distances <- sqrt(rowSums((sweep(train_data, 2, test_point, "-"))^2))
  nearest_indices <- order(distances)[1:k_value]
  return(list(indices = nearest_indices, distances = distances[nearest_indices]))
}

# Create connections dataframe
connections <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:length(tpab_indices)) {
  tpab_idx <- tpab_indices[i]
  
  # Find k nearest rap song neighbors
  neighbors <- find_k_neighbors(
    test_point = feature_matrix[tpab_idx, ],
    train_data = feature_matrix[rap_indices, ],
    k_value = k
  )
  
  for (j in 1:k) {
    rap_idx <- rap_indices[neighbors$indices[j]]
    
    connections <- rbind(connections, data.frame(
      tpab_index = i,
      rap_index = rap_idx,
      tpab_song = all_features$track_name[tpab_idx],
      rap_song = all_features$track_name[rap_idx],
      tpab_cluster = tpab_classifications[i],
      rap_cluster = cluster_labels[neighbors$indices[j]],
      distance = neighbors$distances[j],
      x = tsne_df$X[tpab_idx],
      y = tsne_df$Y[tpab_idx],
      xend = tsne_df$X[rap_idx],
      yend = tsne_df$Y[rap_idx],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
}

# Add clean names
connections <- connections %>%
  mutate(
    tpab_song_clean = gsub("Kendrick Lamar - ", "", tpab_song),
    rap_song_clean = gsub("Various Rap Artists - ", "", rap_song),
    connection_label = paste0("TPAB: ", tpab_song_clean, " → Rap: ", rap_song_clean)
  )

cat("\n" , strrep("=", 70), "\n")
cat("KNN CLASSIFICATION METHODOLOGY EXPLAINED\n")
cat(strrep("=", 70), "\n")
cat("1. k-means (unsupervised): Groups 16,992 rap songs into", optimal_k, "thematic clusters\n")
cat("2. KNN (supervised): For each of 16 TPAB songs:\n")
cat("   a. Find", k, "nearest rap songs using Euclidean distance\n")
cat("   b. Check which clusters those rap songs belong to\n")
cat("   c. Assign TPAB song to the most common cluster\n")
cat("   d. Confidence = proportion of neighbors in assigned cluster\n\n")

cat("3. Visual connections:\n")
cat("   - Lines show each TPAB song connected to its", k, "nearest rap songs\n")
cat("   - Distance labels show similarity score (lower = more similar)\n")
cat("   - Colors show thematic cluster assignments\n\n")

# 7. CREATE THE VISUALIZATION
cat("\nCreating enhanced KNN visualization with complete labeling...\n")

# Color palette
cluster_palette <- c("#E41A1C", "#377EB8", "#4DAF4A", "#984EA3")

# Get important rap songs (neighbors) for labeling
important_rap_indices <- unique(connections$rap_index)

# Create enhanced plot
knn_plot <- ggplot() +
  # Background: All rap songs (small, transparent)
  geom_point(data = tsne_df[!tsne_df$is_tpab, ],
             aes(x = X, y = Y, color = factor(class)),
             size = 1, alpha = 0.2, shape = 16) +
  
  # Highlight: Rap songs that are neighbors to TPAB songs
  geom_point(data = tsne_df[important_rap_indices, ],
             aes(x = X, y = Y, color = factor(class)),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.8, shape = 16) +
  
  # KNN connection lines
  geom_segment(data = connections,
               aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend, 
                   color = factor(tpab_cluster)),
               linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.6,
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, "cm"), type = "closed")) +
  
  # TPAB songs
  geom_point(data = tsne_df[tsne_df$is_tpab, ],
             aes(x = X, y = Y, fill = factor(class), size = confidence * 6),
             shape = 24, color = "black", stroke = 1.2) +
  
  # Labels for TPAB songs
  geom_text_repel(
    data = tsne_df[tsne_df$is_tpab, ],
    aes(x = X, y = Y, label = gsub("Kendrick Lamar - ", "", song)),
    size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", color = "black",
    box.padding = 0.6, point.padding = 0.4,
    segment.color = "gray40", segment.size = 0.5
  ) +
  
  # Labels for important rap songs (neighbors)
  geom_text_repel(
    data = tsne_df[important_rap_indices, ],
    aes(x = X, y = Y, label = gsub("Various Rap Artists - ", "", song)),
    size = 2.5, color = "gray30",
    box.padding = 0.3, point.padding = 0.2,
    segment.color = "gray70", segment.size = 0.3,
    max.overlaps = 20
  ) +
  
  # Distance labels on connections
  geom_text(
    data = connections,
    aes(x = (x + xend)/2, y = (y + yend)/2, 
        label = paste0("d=", round(distance, 2))),
    size = 2, color = "darkred", fontface = "bold",
    check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +
  
  # Styling
  scale_color_manual(

  ) +

scale_size_continuous(

) +

  labs(

    subtitle = paste(
      "Lines show KNN connections (k =", k, ") | ",
      "TPAB songs classified by majority vote of nearest rap song neighbors"
    ),
    x = "t-SNE Dimension 1",

    caption = paste(
      "Method: 1) k-means groups rap songs | ",
      "2) KNN classifies TPAB songs | ",
      "3) t-SNE visualizes in 2D"
    )
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal() +

    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),

  )

print(knn_plot)

# Create directory if it doesn't exist
```
